mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals a strong supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a strong demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as related sectors benefit from increased activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST increases by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded and monetary tightening is anticipated.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows and inflation erodes purchasing power.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 decreases and CPIAUCSL increases simultaneously.
